caption: The drawing features a chandelier with a central vertical axis composed of alternating spherical and disc-shaped segments in shades of brown and beige. Emanating from the central axis are twelve slender, curved arms that extend outward and slightly upward. Each arm terminates in a shallow, wide dish or cup colored in light gray tones, which serve as the holders for light sources indicated by small brown cylindrical shapes at the center of each dish. The chandelier is symmetrical, with six arms on each side, and is presented against a plain, off-white background with four small cross marks near each corner of the paper. There is a small inscription in the lower right corner that reads “SERIES A Frame #22.”
title: Wood and Tin Chandelier
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
